beats.headline: MU drops 9.9% on heavy trading volume
beats.explanation: Micron fell 9.91% to close at $321.80 on volume 2.88 times its 30-day average. No company-specific news accompanied the drop, and customer NVIDIA declined a milder 1.40% the same day, indicating an isolated selloff.

beats.headline: MU rallies 8.9% following Form 8-K filing
beats.explanation: Micron gained 8.88% to close at $367.85 on trading volume 2.90 times normal following the filing of a Form 8-K. The advance was company-specific, as customer NVIDIA gained only 0.77% on the day.

beats.headline: MU surges 11.1% despite customer NVIDIA dip
beats.explanation: Micron jumped 11.06% to $640.20 with trading activity reaching 2.51 times the 30-day average. No company-specific news was provided to explain the gain, which decoupled from customer NVIDIA as it fell 1.00%.

beats.headline: MU advances 15.5% on elevated volume
beats.explanation: Micron rose 15.49% to $746.81 on 2.54 times average volume, extending its recent surge. No company-specific news was provided for the move, though customer NVIDIA also traded higher by 1.75%.

beats.headline: MU gains 19.3% in sharp upward breakout
beats.explanation: Micron advanced 19.29% to close at $895.88 on volume 2.99 times its 30-day average. The rally was distinct to Micron, as customer NVIDIA slipped 0.22%, but no company-specific news was cited.

beats.headline: MU slides 7.7% while customer NVIDIA gains
beats.explanation: Micron dropped 7.74% to $996.00 on volume 2.14 times average after trading above $1079. No company-specific news explained the pullback, which was company-specific as customer NVIDIA rose 1.82%.

beats.headline: MU falls 13.3% in shared downturn with NVIDIA
beats.explanation: Micron declined 13.25% to $864.01 on heavy volume 3.01 times its normal level. No company-specific catalyst was provided, and the loss was shared with customer NVIDIA, which dropped 6.20% the same day.

beats.headline: MU rebounds 11.7% following recent 8-K filing
beats.explanation: Micron climbed 11.66% to $995.87 on 2.32 times average volume, two days after submitting a Form 8-K filing on June 9. Customer NVIDIA also moved higher, rising 2.22% on the session.

beats.headline: MU sheds 13.2% as customer NVIDIA retreats
beats.explanation: Micron sank 13.18% to $1051.77 on volume 2.35 times its 30-day average. The downward move was shared with customer NVIDIA, which shed 4.13%, with no company-specific news provided in the evidence.

beats.headline: MU jumps 15.7% after 10-Q and 8-K filings
beats.explanation: Micron rallied 15.74% to close at $1213.56 on 3.20 times average volume. The jump was supported by a Form 10-Q filed the same day alongside an 8-K filed on June 24, while customer NVIDIA fell 1.64%.

beats.headline: MU tumbles 8.9% on 2.4x average volume
beats.explanation: Micron decreased 8.85% to $820.53 with trading volume reaching 2.38 times normal levels. There was no company-specific news to account for the drop, which occurred while customer NVIDIA gained 0.25%.

beats.headline: MU surges 18.4% alongside customer NVIDIA
beats.explanation: Micron climbed 18.36% to finish at $874.66 on volume 2.46 times its 30-day average. No company-specific news was reported, though customer NVIDIA also traded up, gaining 2.65% the same day.

arc: Between late March and late July 2026, Micron experienced dramatic volatility, rising from $321.80 to a peak of $1213.56 before retreating to $874.66. While regulatory disclosures—notably an early April 8-K and late June 10-Q and 8-K filings—marked key upside inflections, the majority of the double-digit swings occurred without company-specific news. Micron frequently decoupled from its customer NVIDIA, experiencing significantly amplified swings during shared moves and sharp independent runs that highlight elevated idiosyncratic price action.
